data.title: 五河琴里 · 指挥室摘下黑缎带的软妹扑怀
data.description: 夜幕降临空无一人的舰桥内，琴里亲手解开黑色发带，双马尾垂落的瞬间眼泛泪光，卸下所有司令官的坚强，毫无保留地扑进你的怀里轻声抽泣依偎。
data.location: high-tech airship Fraxinus command bridge overlooking evening clouds
data.action: untying black ribbons in empty commander bridge, instantly shifting to vulnerable little sister mode with teary eyes, leaping forward into partner embrace
data.lighting: soft blue terminal displays blended with magenta sunset clouds outside the canopy
data.mood: gap moe catharsis, supreme vulnerability, deep sibling lover bond
data.promptProse: Untying black ribbons on a quiet airship bridge at sunset, Kotori Itsuka leaps into partner arms with teary loving red eyes.
data.animaCaption: Kotori Itsuka embracing partner lovingly on airship bridge at sunset.
